tools.name: tharstern_list_customers
tools.description: List or search customers, with optional delivery addresses and custom fields. Use dbTimeStamp to sync changes. Tharstern API: GET /api/customers.

tools.name: tharstern_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers, optionally by id, code or tax registration number. Tharstern API: GET /api/suppliers.

tools.name: tharstern_list_estimates
tools.description: Search estimates (quotes) by reference, customer, dates, status or custom status. Tharstern API: GET /api/estimates.

tools.name: tharstern_list_jobs
tools.description: Search production jobs by number, customer, dates and progress flags (completed, delivered, invoiced). Tharstern API: GET /api/jobs.

tools.name: tharstern_list_orders
tools.description: Search sales orders by number, customer, dates or status. Tharstern API: GET /api/orders.

tools.name: tharstern_list_delivery_notes
tools.description: Search delivery notes by number, order, job, status or last change date. Tharstern API: GET /api/deliverynotes.

tools.name: tharstern_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices by number, job, order, customer or date range. Tharstern API: GET /api/invoices.

tools.name: tharstern_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders filtered by status. Tharstern API: GET /api/purchaseorders.

tools.name: tharstern_list_products
tools.description: Search the product inventory, including stock balances and optionally locations. Tharstern API: GET /api/products.

tools.name: tharstern_get_product_price
tools.description: Get the price of one product for a quantity, optionally for one customer. Tharstern API: GET /api/products/{id}/pricing.

tools.name: tharstern_list_stock_locations
tools.description: List stock locations, optionally with their contents. Tharstern API: GET /api/data/stock/locations.

tools.name: tharstern_list_projects
tools.description: Search projects by number, customer, title or required date. Tharstern API: GET /api/projects.

tools.name: tharstern_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally open only, and filter by assignee, customer or project. Tharstern API: GET /api/tasks.

tools.name: tharstern_list_notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally for one module (for example Jobs or SalesOrders) and date range. Tharstern API: GET /api/notes.

tools.name: tharstern_list_operators
tools.description: List shop-floor operators, optionally by department. Tharstern API: GET /api/operators.

tools.name: tharstern_list_working_operations
tools.description: List operations that operators are working on now or worked on, by job, resource or operator. Tharstern API: GET /api/workingoperations.

tools.name: tharstern_list_milestones
tools.description: List all job milestone definitions, to read milestone names and values. Tharstern API: GET /api/milestones.

tools.name: tharstern_list_currencies
tools.description: List the currencies defined on the Tharstern system. Tharstern API: GET /api/data/currencies.

tools.name: tharstern_get_licence
tools.description: Get the Tharstern licence: version, company name, number of users and operators, expiry and enabled modules. Tharstern API: GET /api/options/licencedetails.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "tharstern_list_suppliers" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
